description: Retrieve the change history for a Swedish company — attribute_changed events showing when values were first observed and what changed. Optionally filter by attribute key. Returns temporal bounds (effective_from) and evidence for each event.

attribute_key.description: Optional: filter to events for a specific attribute (e.g. 'employee_count', 'legal_form')

limit.description: Maximum number of events to return (default 50, max 200)

name: get_company_history
